rationale: Command list query now ordered by description; previously unordered.
Pre-receive hook no longer checks merge-queue branch updates, so pushes/API ref updates previously rejected for merge queue branches are now accepted.
Method rename executeWithResult to execute only; same behaviour.
OAuth authorize/userinfo and OIDC login placeholders now return 405 failed instead of 200 success; /oauth/redirect route removed, /oidc/redirect added returning 405.
Removes env toggle and automated-sync condition for revision-update optimisation; intended same manifests, performance only; signature edits cosmetic.
Implicit subscription no longer skipped when an inherited subscription exists; now creates own subscription row.
Snapshots list applies configured default limit when no limit param given; no effect if config is 0.
Webhook handler passes triggerUser instead of user to notification of potentially containing entries; recipient/context of recommended action may differ.
ViewNameResolver replaced by TemplateNameResolver interface; imports moved; no visible behaviour change shown.
Widget handler creates default session registry when none configured; previously nil registry, likely failing on use.
Import path change of pop library only.
Utility no longer treats TimeoutException as interrupt; HTTP-visible effect not determinable.
Adds optional Prometheus metrics servlet on admin port when configured; not an API operation.
Identity import of passkey credentials now returns 400 when user handle or credentials are empty; previously stored.
